description: Entity slot tag (principal / action / resource origin) must be cleared when an entity value crosses a composite-expression or container boundary (record literal, set literal, if-then-else). Otherwise a derived entity such as ({p: principal}).p would still consult principal_parents in `in` evaluation and flip permit / forbid decisions. The C subset relies on slot tagging because it has per-slot parent arrays rather than a global entity store, so once the syntactic chain to the principal / action / resource keyword is broken the derived value must match reflexively only. Cedar's spec model resolves ancestors by UID and would still match through the entity store, so these scenarios diverge from the oracle and are marked c_limit.

tests.name: record_pulled_entity_does_not_consult_principal_parents
tests.description: ({p: principal}).p in <group> must not match through principal_parents — the record value is a derived entity without a slot tag
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { ({p: principal}).p in Group::"readers" };

tests.name: record_pulled_entity_does_not_consult_resource_parents
tests.description: ({r: resource}).r in <group> must not match through resource_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { ({r: resource}).r in Group::"public" };

tests.name: record_pulled_entity_reflexive_in_still_matches
tests.description: reflexive `in` (entity in itself) must still match for record-pulled entities
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { ({p: principal}).p in User::"alice" };

tests.name: if_then_entity_does_not_consult_principal_parents
tests.description: if-then result that picks principal must not consult principal_parents — the if expression breaks the syntactic chain
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { (if true then principal else resource) in Group::"readers" };

tests.name: if_else_entity_does_not_consult_resource_parents
tests.description: if-else result that picks resource must not consult resource_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { (if false then principal else resource) in Group::"public" };

tests.name: if_then_entity_reflexive_in_still_matches
tests.description: reflexive `in` must still match for if-then-else results
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { (if true then principal else resource) in User::"alice" };

tests.name: nested_record_pulled_entity_does_not_consult_principal_parents
tests.description: ({outer: {inner: principal}}).outer.inner in <group> must not leak slot through nested records
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { ({outer: {inner: principal}}).outer.inner in Group::"readers" };

tests.name: direct_principal_still_consults_principal_parents
tests.description: sanity check: bare `principal in <group>` (no composite) must still consult principal_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { principal in Group::"readers" };
